hard_negatives.instruction: Overhead medium shot of a tan pit bull dog sitting still on gray concrete beside a yellow bone. The same dog remains seated and keeps its head away from the bone; it never touches, grips, lifts, or holds the bone. Natural daylight, stable camera, anatomically consistent dog.

Overhead medium shot of a tan pit bull dog sitting on gray concrete beside a yellow bone. The same dog lowers its head and sniffs near the bone but never touches, grips, lifts, or holds it; the bone remains on the floor. Natural daylight, stable camera, anatomically consistent dog.
